method.sampling: Direct tagged LuaLaTeX pass; process RSS sampled every 0.5 seconds; LuaTeX counters at 100-page checkpoints, before/after tagpdf finalizer, and around cleanup.
method.reference: Private tagpdf finalizer wrapper emits before/after phase markers but does not clear Lua tables.
method.candidate: Same wrapper, then clears ltx.__tag mc/struct/tables/page and runs full Lua GC after finalizer returns.

interpretation.finding: All six PDFs have identical semantic audits. The Lua heap is reduced by roughly 358-370 MiB by the cleanup candidate, but paired peak RSS deltas vary from -94.53 to +7.09 MiB.
limitations: Three pairs on one host and one synthetic fixture do not establish a stable peak-RSS improvement.
Every candidate high-water RSS sample precedes the finalizer wrapper; the 0.5-second sampler did not capture a candidate RSS sample after cleanup because cleanup occurs just before process exit.
The finalizer name is a private tagpdf API and the probe is diagnostic only.
interpretation.decision: Do not integrate the cleanup. It runs after the build peak and the measurements do not show a stable reduction in peak RSS. Continue profiling allocations that accumulate before finalization while preserving the full tagged PDF.
